title: Blues pianists and surviving figures from the district
summary: Allen and Punch discuss blues piano players, a woman pianist on St. Peter, and whether Mrs. Tom Anderson is alive, before a break.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I remember that. Did you know Burman have a black peep? Let's both play piano. No.
They might have played after I left. I mean.
No this was probably before you got in. The folks have really played the blues.
Well they had a lot of them blues played around here for her on piano.
I wonder what ever happened to Rappi?

This woman right down on this street. What street we on? St. Peter? Yeah right down there. She used to be a piano player in the nightclub. Larry know her name good. You know who I'm talking about. She lived 10, 1010 I believe. St. Peter. Johnson I think. Yeah well she used to play in the nightclub.
Cause I went there to get her one night for Larry. For Larry.

And she come on down and played some numbers. You know. Is any of these characters around that had these joints during that time? Is any of them still living? Who? Some of them some of the wives. Who?
Mrs. Tom Anderson is supposed to be alive.
Have you ever. Well she would know nothing about it though.
She might. I want to know. Well Lula White died didn't she? Say Poncha.
Can y'all talk for a minute? Yeah.
I got to go take a little beach.
